# Organisation

An organisation that interacts with the estate — legal firms, financial institutions, charities, dealers, funeral providers, employers, government bodies, and others. Maps to schema:Organization in JSON-LD

Source: [`v3/organisation.json`](../../v3/organisation.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/organisation.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this organisation within the INHERIT document |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The organisation's legal or trading name |
| `organisationType` | one of `legal_firm`, `financial_institution`, `pension_provider`, `insurance_provider`, `dealer`, `auction_house`, `valuation_firm`, `funeral_provider`, `charity`, `religious_institution`, `employer`, `trust_corporation`, `accountancy_firm`, `government_body`, `retailer`, `manufacturer`, `property_management`, `storage_facility`, `digital_platform`, `utility_provider`, … (+1 more) or `string` | yes | The nature of the organisation. Use x-inherit- prefix for jurisdiction-specific or niche types not covered by the core enum |
| `estateRoles` | array of one of `beneficiary`, `will_writer`, `executor`, `trustee`, `asset_holder`, `liability_holder`, `insurer`, `valuer`, `recommended_dealer`, `funeral_provider`, `professional_adviser`, `regulatory_body`, `employer`, `retailer`, `service_provider` or `string` | | The roles this organisation plays in this specific estate. An organisation may play multiple roles |
| `jurisdiction` | `string` | | Primary jurisdiction where this organisation operates. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code |
| `address` | [PostalAddress](common/address.md) | | The organisation's address |
| `url` | `string` (uri) | | The organisation's website |
| `email` | `string` (email) | | Primary contact email |
| `phone` | `string` | | Primary contact phone number |
| `logo` | `string` (uri) | | URL to the organisation's logo |
| `wikidataId` | `string` | | Wikidata Q-number for this organisation, enabling linked data resolution. Many major organisations have Wikidata entries with structured data (founding date, parent company, headquarters, etc.) |
| `description` | `string` | | Brief description of the organisation and its relevance to this estate |
| `registrations` | array of [Registration](#def-Registration) | | Registrations with regulatory bodies, professional associations, and government registries. An organisation may hold multiple registrations across jurisdictions |
| `contactPerson` | `string` | | Name of the primary contact person at this organisation for estate matters |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this organisation's relationship to the estate |
| `ratings` | array of `object` | | Aggregate ratings from review platforms. One entry per platform. Supports user decision-making, agent filtering/ranking, and point-in-time audit trails |
| `sameAs` | array of `string` (uri) | | URIs identifying this entity elsewhere (schema.org sameAs). e.g. Wikidata, LinkedIn, DBpedia |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `vatConfiguration` | `object` | | The organisation's VAT registration status and scheme. Affects how VAT is calculated on transactions involving this organisation |
| `internationalShipping` | `object` | | International shipping capabilities and policies for this organisation |
| `identifiers` | array of [Identifier](common/identifier.md) | | External identifiers — charity number, company registration, UEN, etc. |
| `dealerProfile` | `object` | | Dealer-specific profile information. Only relevant for organisations that operate as dealers on marketplace or catalogue platforms |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-Registration"></a>

### Registration

A registration with a regulatory body, professional association, or government registry

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `string` | yes | The regulatory body or registry. Use an id from well-known-organisations.json where available, or a descriptive string for unlisted bodies |
| `number` | `string` | yes | The registration number. Format varies by body — see well-known-organisations.json for expected patterns |
| `status` | one of `active`, `suspended`, `revoked`, `voluntary`, `expired` | | Current status of this registration |
| `jurisdiction` | `string` | | Jurisdiction this registration applies to. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code |
| `verificationUrl` | `string` (uri) | | URL to verify this registration with the regulatory body |
| `verifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this registration was last verified |
| `liveCheck` | `object` | | Result of a live API check against this registry. Snapshot at retrievedAt. Registry-specific fields are validated conditionally based on the parent body field |
